mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video (v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag, v_series, v_season, v_number, v_file) VALUES (#{vName}, #{vType}, #{vRank}, #{vAuthor}, #{vTag}, #{vSeries}, #{vSeason}, #{vNumber}, #{vFile})
mapper.select: SELECT id, v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag, v_series, v_season, v_number, v_file FROM video ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET v_name = #{vName}, v_type = #{vType}, v_rank = #{vRank}, v_author = #{vAuthor}, v_tag = #{vTag}, v_series = #{vSeries}, v_season = #{vSeason}, v_number = #{vNumber}, v_file = #{vFile} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag, v_series, v_season, v_number, v_file FROM video
AND ( LOWER(v_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_type) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_series) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_tag) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_rank) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_season) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
AND LOWER(v_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_type) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_rank) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{rank}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{author}, '%'))
AND ( LOWER(v_tag) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_tag) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{tag}, ' %')) OR LOWER(v_tag) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('% ', #{tag}, '%')) OR LOWER(v_tag) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('% ', #{tag}, ' %')) )
AND LOWER(v_series) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{series}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_season) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{season}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_number) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{number}, '%'))
AND LOWER(v_file) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{file}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC
